2608.13560.title: AutoDesign: Meta-Harness Optimization for Long-Horizon Agentic Design
2608.13560.paper_summary: Transforming multimodal sources into condensed and structured media outputs can be fundamentally conceptualized as a long-horizon agentic process centered on a model-harness system. While an ideal harness system should align with human design priors and accumulate reusable experience through empirical exploration to drive recursive self-improvement, existing paradigms remain static and fall short of this capability. In this paper, we present AutoDesign, a framework that aligns with human design priors, where a meta-harness optimizer guides a code agent to recursively improve harness based on rollout feedback. To instantiate and evaluate this framework, we focus on the academic paper-to-poster generation task and introduce PosterBench, comprising a 100-paper Main Track spanning five disciplines and PosterBench-mini, a shared 10-paper subset for controlled evaluation. On the PosterBench Main Track, AutoDesign achieves the highest score of 78.32, surpassing the closed-source commercial system Claude Design by 7.45 points. Across seven controlled code-agent-model configurations, integrating the learned DesignHarness consistently improves performance, increasing the average PosterBench Score from 54.99 to 67.39 (+12.4%). In a fully autonomous long-horizon loop, it executes 253 tool calls and 11 editing turns within 40 minutes for under $3, reaching average conference-poster quality in human evaluation. A system-blind human study further demonstrates that AutoDesign achieves the highest human preference among evaluated systems.
2608.13560.paper_summary_zh: 將多模態來源轉化為濃縮且結構化的媒體輸出，基本上可以概念化為一個以模型為中心的長期代理過程。雖然理想的鞍系統應該與人類設計的先驗知識相一致，並通過實證探索積累可重用的經驗以驅動遞歸自我改進，但現有的範式仍然靜態，無法達到這一能力。在本文中，我們提出了AutoDesign，一個與人類設計先驗知識相一致的框架，其中元鞍優化器指導代碼代理基於回饋進行遞歸改進。為了實現和評估這一框架，我們專注於學術論文到海報的生成任務，並介紹了PosterBench，包括跨越五個學科的100篇論文的主軌道和一個共享的10篇論文子集PosterBench-mini，用於控制評估。在PosterBench主軌道上，AutoDesign達到了78.32的最高分，超過了封閉源商業系統Claude Design 7.45分。在七個控制的代碼代理模型配置中，整合學習到的DesignHarness始終提高性能，將平均PosterBench分數從54.99提高到67.39（+12.4%）。在一個完全自主的長期循環中，它在40分鐘內執行了253次工具調用和11次編輯回合，成本低於3美元，達到了人類評估中的平均會議海報質量。一項系統盲測的人類研究進一步證明，AutoDesign在評估的系統中實現了最高的人類偏好。
